summary: Build a Wooden Spoon-themed memecoin on the Internet Computer (ICP) with built-in DAO governance where each token represents a vote.
architectural_notes: Governance model: token-weighted voting (1 token = 1 vote).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Memecoin logo illustration of a wooden spoon with playful meme-coin styling, transparent background (wooden-spoon-coin-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide banner/hero illustration with a wooden spoon motif, warm wood textures, and meme-like vibe (wooden-spoon-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
- Small app icon featuring a simplified wooden spoon emblem, transparent background (wooden-spoon-icon.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a simple DAO treasury mechanism tied to the token: a dedicated treasury balance controlled by the canister, plus UI/logic to view treasury balance and to execute accepted “treasury transfer” proposals.

Build a React UI for the Wooden Spoon memecoin + DAO that works with Internet Identity: connect/disconnect, show the logged-in principal, show token balance, transfer tokens, and provide DAO screens to create proposals, browse proposals, vote, and execute accepted proposals.

Apply a coherent “Wooden Spoon” memecoin visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, layout, and key components) inspired by playful DIY/wood textures and meme-coin energy, without using a blue/purple default palette.
Add generated static image assets for the Wooden Spoon memecoin branding and render them in the UI (stored under frontend/public/assets/generated).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a memecoin on ICP (Internet Computer) with token canister deployed on-chain
Add DAO governance elements where each token equals one vote (token-weighted voting)
Brand/theme the token as the Wooden Spoon meme coin based on the iconic video

Implement a Motoko canister that provides a fungible memecoin token (“Wooden Spoon”) with core on-chain functionality: token metadata (name, symbol, decimals), total supply, per-principal balances, and transfer between principals.

Add DAO governance to the same Motoko canister with token-weighted voting where each token equals one vote: proposal creation, proposal listing/detail, voting (yes/no/abstain), quorum/threshold rules, voting deadline, and proposal finalization/execution for at least one meaningful on-chain action.
